records.name: Austin

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi unavailable this session (WebSearch budget was already exhausted; direct levels.fyi fetch returned an empty JS-rendered page). Fallback used: BLS OEWS May 2023, Austin-Round Rock, TX metro, Software Developers (SOC 15-1252) - median hourly wage $63.14 x 2080 hrs = $131,331 used as 'mid'. new_grad/senior derived by applying national BLS 25th- and 90th-percentile-to-median ratios (0.77x / 1.58x) to the metro median.
